sable_player_ragdoll_patch.configuration: Fixes Curios rendering on ragdoll part block entities: feet map to both legs, rings and hand items are distributed across arms by slot index, and the opposite limb is hidden during rendering to prevent duplicate rendering.
When Iris/Oculus is installed, renders ragdoll player skins with the vanilla PlayerModel cutout render type to avoid translucent entity sorting hiding rear faces or transparent cosmetics.

When enabled, ragdolls holding luminous items such as torches emit dynamic light through Sodium/Embeddium Dynamic Lights and LambDynamicLights, and the ragdoll model itself is brightened to match the held light.
Applies hidden armor and cosmetic armor overrides from Cosmetic Armor Reworked and Accessories when rendering ragdoll corpses.
Renders Dynamic Lantern waist items and Beltborne Lanterns/Accessories Layer lamps on ragdoll corpses, and lets supported waist lanterns contribute to ragdoll dynamic lights.
Hides capes on ragdoll corpses even if the player had cape rendering enabled. Other skin customization parts still follow the player's settings captured at death.
Cancels block interactions, such as opening chests or pressing buttons, while the player is grabbing a ragdoll part.
Default state of No-Collide mode when the server or world loads. When enabled, ragdoll part blocks have no collision to reduce players and mobs getting stuck.
When ragdoll-corpse is installed, prevents interacting with a ragdoll corpse while the player is grabbing any part of that ragdoll.
